messages:
tanya: Heads up — planning a shift-swap + fallback drill for the kernel+quant rollout. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner. Proposed window: Tue 01:30-03:30 UTC. Who can take deploy?

matt: I can take deploy ownership for that window. Will be oncall. Prefer a short rehearsal 1h prior. :thumbsup:

orion: FYI infra maintenance in us-west is slated 03:00-03:30 UTC. We should avoid full overlap. Can we start earlier or do region-stagger?

tanya: Good catch. How about 01:30-03:30 still but keep us-west slices last (03:00+), or shift to 01:00-03:00? Thoughts?

julie: I’ll own smoke checks. Plan: rehearsal 00:30 UTC (30m dry-run), then smoke at +5m after canary spin. Smoke checklist quick: run smoke script, sanity prompts, p50 latency and error-rate. I’ll post the smoke script in runbook.

kevin: I’ll own rollback readiness. I’ll pre-publish rollback artifacts and document quick rollback steps. Rollback command I’ll test:
```
./deploy rollback --slot $SLOT --to-image rollback-2201
```
Also will prepare a KV-cache flush probe: `python tools/kv_flush_check.py --slice $SLOT`

deploy-bot: Deploy window created by @tanya: Tue 2025-07-08 01:30-03:30 UTC — https://deploys.internal/redwood/rollout/2218765432

matt: For canary plan: start 10% traffic on slices a1,a2 for 15m. If no errors, ramp to 30% for 20m, then 100% by manual go. Will tag canary slices with `canary-2207` and monitor error spikes.

julie: Smoke checklist (condensed):
1) sample prompt set (10 queries) pass correctness
2) perf p50 <= 120ms and p95 <= 400ms on sample workload
3) no increase in 5xx > 0.5% for canary window
4) KV cache hit rate stable or improved
I’ll watch logs + create a quick dashboard view. Who watches tracing?

orion: I’ll watch infra stuff (GPU mem, disk, network). I’ll stand by for the us-west slice handoff and keep the maintenance window info. If anything looks off, I’ll coordinate rollback with @kevin.

tanya: Okay locking: deploy owner = @matt, smoke owner = @julie, rollback owner = @kevin, infra watcher = @orion. Rehearsal (dry-run) 1h before (00:30 UTC). I’ll update the runbook and the calendar block. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Pre-uploading rollback image to S3 and validating checksum now: `s3://redwood-rollbacks/rollback-2201.tar.gz` (sha256: abc123...) I’ll also stage the rollback job so `./deploy rollback` is a quick op.

matt: Sounds good. One ask: for quant profile changes, ensure the model fallback mapping exists so traffic can be routed to the non-quant variant if perf regresses.

kevin: Agreed. I’ll add an automated fallback policy in config: `fallback.priority: [quant-v2, quant-v1, float32]` and validate compatibility locally.

deploy-bot: Reminder: us-west maintenance overlaps at 03:00-03:30 UTC — plan to keep us-west last in the ramp.

julie: Got it. I’ll prepare the smoke script and the dashboard. I’ll also have a rapid checklist pinned in the runbook channel with commands:
```
# smoke run
./scripts/smoke_run.sh --slices a1,a2 --samples samples/smoke_set.json
# kv probe
python tools/kv_flush_check.py --slice a1 --expect-hitrate 0.7
```

orion: I’ll be on-call for infra metrics during window. If we need to abort, ping me and I’ll cut traffic and coordinate rollback with @kevin.

tanya: Thanks everyone — closing loop. I’ll post final rehearsal time and tag the calendar. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:

matt: 👍

julie: On it, will post smoke links 1h before.

orion: OK — standby.

kevin: Rollback artifacts staged and tested. Ready.

tanya: Final note: please don’t merge any related PRs to runtime/config between now and the rehearsal except hotfixes. Tag me if you must.

matt: Noted, will freeze relevant PRs.

julie: Acknowledged.
